Name: Estrogen Pills
Author: roabotics
Description:
Adds two new items and two new machines.

Items:
﻿Cholesterol - Used as an ingredient for Estrogen 
﻿Estrogen - When enough is consumed by a player their gender will be changed to female.

Machines:
       Cholesterol Maker - Uses eggs or milk to produce cholesterol (Unlocked at mining level 6)
﻿  ﻿Estrogen Maker - Uses 5 cholesterol to produce estrogen (Unlocked at mining level 7)

Notes:
       Estrogen is either a disliked gift, a liked gift, or a loved gift depending on the NPC.
